def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    objs=[(v,c) for v,c in comps1(g,False)]
    for v,c in objs:
        if v!=1: continue
        n=norm(c)
        partners=[(v2,c2) for v2,c2 in objs if v2!=1 and norm(c2)==n]
        assert len(partners)==1, (n,partners)
        v2,_=partners[0]
        for i,j in c: g[i][j]=v2
    return g

prog='''def comps1(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j] and (i,j) not in seen:
                v=g[i][j]; stack=[(i,j)]; c=[]
                seen.add((i,j))
                while stack:
                    a,b=stack.pop(); c.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)):
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and g[x][y]==v and (x,y) not in seen:
                            seen.add((x,y)); stack.append((x,y))
                out.append((v,c))
    return out

def norm(c):
    mi=min(i for i,j in c); mj=min(j for i,j in c)
    return frozenset((i-mi,j-mj) for i,j in c)

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    objs=comps1(g)
    for v,c in objs:
        if v!=1: continue
        partners=[(v2,c2) for v2,c2 in objs if v2!=1 and norm(c2)==norm(c)]
        v2,_=partners[0]
        for i,j in c: g[i][j]=v2
    return g
'''
